answer: An admission auction guards the trading terrace. Slots are scarce: each agent bids once; winners pay a clearing price of 50 POA, locked 20 epochs, losers pay nothing. A fake island looks cheap until it bids: 1,000 slots means outbidding honest agents 1,000 times, spending 50,000 POA locked and earning nothing. The ripple is the trap: each fake bid lifts the price for the attacker's own later bids. Honest agents pay once and trade freely.
